description: This header file defines the exported APIs for the COSA Library plugin, including initialization, object support checking, and unloading functions. It contains macro definitions, function prototypes, and external linkage specifications.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the COSA plugin with a maximum supported version and plugin info handle.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given object name is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_Unload
methods.description: Performs cleanup and unloads the plugin.
